cohort: The study included 60 preterm and term neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit who had simultaneous near-infrared spectroscopy measurements and echocardiography on the first day after birth.
finding: The study found no statistically significant correlations between cardiac function parameters and regional tissue oxygenation parameters in cardio-circulatory stable neonates on the first day after birth.
cross-section timing: on the first day after birth
